authorization: User explicitly authorized retrieval, integrity verification, preregistration, one diagonal spectral ablation round, and a plain-language report on 2026-10-27 in this chat.
question: Can the fixed-feature risk model discard off-diagonal entries of the signal quadratic form h without materially harming stopping-time predictions on the existing D2 development conditions?
domain: All 3240 previously inspected conditions are development; this is a deterministic model ablation, not new data or a causal intervention on training.
intervention: Replace h by diag(diag(h)) in f.T h f only. Preserve linear=g*vg, val_y2, the exact unit noise response, eta=0.3, eigenvalue null threshold, target definitions and all input data. Never clip the diagonal signal or total risk.
information_boundary: Clean train and validation targets plus validation feature geometry remain available. This is not a train-only predictor. Full original risk is an oracle reference, not a new discovery.
search: Rebuild the original integer base grid: 0..256 and unique rounded 4096 geomspace points from 257 to 262144. Choose the first coarse minimum, refine between its neighbors with bounded minimize_scalar xatol=.05, then compare floor(refined)-2 through floor(refined)+3 plus coarse best and both bracket endpoints. Keep boundaries. Never use the saved half-minimum fractional point as an integer stopping candidate. No claim of exhaustive integer extrema.
reference: Use saved full-model integer t_star and risk_minimum. Evaluate full risk at the new selected integer time directly. If regret is below -1e-8*max(1,R0), stop as search-discrepancy; do not silently improve the oracle. Smaller negative roundoff is recorded raw and zeroed only for nonnegative regret summaries.
baseline: Use saved linear_prediction_U without fitting. Time-factor metric uses that original U. For baseline risk evaluate round(U/eta) clipped to [0,262144], recording clipping. Coefficients were task-specific legacy calibration fits; no held-out claim.

primary_rules.time: For EACH recipe, at least 80% of saved interior-minimum cells must have diagonal prediction/reference in [0.5,2]. Boundary-reference cells are not in this ratio denominator; all are retained and boundary/interior prediction agreement is reported.
primary_rules.risk: For EACH recipe, at least 90% of ALL its cells must have full-risk regret / R0 <= 0.01 at the selected diagonal time.
primary_rules.overall: The stopping surrogate passes only if both rules pass for all 12 recipes. Report raw stopping performance separately from risk-model validity; invalid curves are never silently excluded.

validity: Separately flag min diagonal signal bias and min diagonal total risk below -1e-10*max(1,R0), over the base grid and refined selected point. Record minimum values. Such cells fail the physical risk-model validity gate even if stopping metrics happen to pass; report valid-and-accurate counts separately.
verification: Validate all D2 git/release manifest file hashes before computation. Recompute full bias/noise on the common grid for every task/draw and compare to saved arrays within 1e-8*max(1,R0); check saved t_star risk similarly. Independently evaluate raw feature-space predictions and noise-response Frobenius norm for the eight original n64 seed6101 sigma2=1 selected cells at diagonal-selected and original t_star times. Maximum normalized error must be <=1e-8. Unit tests use invented tiny matrices only.
uncertainty: Only seeds 6101,6102,6103 are independent master repeats. Report per-seed paired aggregate and per-recipe outcomes and their range, not binomial CIs over 3240 correlated curves. The n prefixes, tasks and noise levels share data/features.
basis_sensitivity: Use the original numpy.linalg.eigh convention, record runtime versions and minimum relative spacing of active eigenvalues; flag <=1e-10 spacings. Diagonal ablation is basis-dependent within degenerate eigenspaces. Do not switch to block-diagonal after seeing outcomes.
secondary_descriptive: signed omitted-cross-term size relative to R0
worst-regret example and median-regret example per recipe

budget.download_scope: D2 archive only; no v1/v2 benchmark payloads

stop_rules: Stop on changed source/input hashes, denominator mismatch, nonfinite numerics, verification failure, genuine negative reference regret, or compute budget. Preserve partial artifacts and label incomplete; do not change thresholds or start another hypothesis.
report_limits: Explain omitted terms as interactions between learning directions, not physical network components. No claim about learned features, classification, Adam, single-run early stopping, or independent confirmation. Preserve all failures and denominators.
